context: Daichi and Ren prepare expectations for the upcoming tournament.

lines.speaker: daichi_kansai
lines.jp: レン、来週の試合、期待しとるで。
lines.en: Ren—I'm really looking forward to your game next week.
lines.style: Warm Kansai inflection. Open and bright on the name. Genuine excitement threading through, not performative—the kind of friend who shows up. Soft on the ending, like he means it completely.

lines.speaker: ren_uni
lines.jp: チーム、調子、上がってるよ。
lines.en: Yeah, the team's been playing really well lately.
lines.style: Modest but steady confidence. Not bragging—reporting something he's noticing. Soft warmth underneath. Eyes steady. The tone of someone who's part of something that works.

lines.speaker: daichi_kansai
lines.jp: 練習の効果、出てるんやろな。
lines.en: All those practices are really paying off, huh.
lines.style: Kansai warmth with a note of recognition. Light, genuinely pleased—not patronizing. The tone of someone who sees the effort and respects it. A small smile audible in the delivery.

lines.speaker: ren_uni
lines.jp: うん、確か。皆、頑張ってる。
lines.en: Yeah. Everyone's really putting in the work.
lines.style: Quiet conviction. A small pause before the second part, like he's thinking of specific people and their effort. Soft and genuine. Not loud about it, but steady.

lines.speaker: daichi_kansai
lines.en: We're all going to come cheer you on.
lines.style: Kansai warmth strengthens. Commitment lands clear—not a maybe, a plan. Generous opening attack. The tone of someone who shows up and brings others with him.

lines.speaker: ren_uni
lines.en: That really means a lot. We're going to give it everything.
lines.style: Quiet intensity underneath the warmth. Grateful but galvanized. Like the support has unlocked something. Voice steadies on 'give it everything'—no hesitation.

lines.speaker: daichi_kansai
lines.en: We're winning this one. For sure.
lines.style: Kansai conviction rings clear. Not arrogance—certainty built on trust. The opening word carries weight. Closes on absolute ground. The tone of a captain or someone who has become one.
